inclusions.text: Met at Luxor International Airport and transferred to the cruiser
inclusions.source: You are met at Luxor International Airport and transferred to your five-star Nile cruiser.

Lunch is served on board, and the afternoon begins at Karnak — not a single temple but a succession of temples, chapels, pylons, and courts built and enlarged by pharaoh after pharaoh across roughly 1,500 years.
You arrive by horse-drawn carriage and visit after dark, when the floodlit columns stand clean against the sky.
The day ends with a felucca sail around Kitchener's Island, the botanical garden established by Lord Kitchener in the 1890s.
The morning begins at the Philae Temple complex, dedicated to the goddess Isis and reached by motorboat to Agilkia Island.

inclusions.text: Final breakfast and transfer to Aswan International Airport
inclusions.source: After a final breakfast on the Nile, you are transferred to Aswan International Airport.

itinerary.title: Edfu and Kom Ombo: the river days
